properties.title: M6.6 Earthquake — Tual, Indonesia
properties.summary: M6.6 at 68km depth, 148km WSW of Tual, Indonesia. No tsunami warning issued.

properties.title: Russia strikes Kyiv bridges (North/South)
properties.summary: Overnight Nov 17 strikes on North and South bridges in Kyiv. Klitschko reports preliminary bridge damage. 2 deaths, 1 injured in Kyiv.

properties.title: Ukraine strikes Crimean Bridge (arch collapse)
properties.summary: Ukrainian Neptune missile strike reportedly collapsed one arch of the Kerch Strait/Crimean Bridge overnight Nov 16-17. Unconfirmed by Western outlets.

properties.title: Ukraine strikes Akhtubinsk airfield (Astrakhan)
properties.summary: Military airfield near Akhtubinsk in Astrakhan struck overnight. Multiple explosions reported. ZSU confirms strikes on Russian fuel/drone infrastructure.

properties.title: Russian drone strike — Vapniarka, Vinnytsia
properties.summary: Large fire in Vapniarka (Vinnytsia region) from Russian drone strike.

properties.title: Russian drones strike Kherson
properties.summary: Fire in Kherson from Russian drone strikes. Nov 16.

properties.title: Russian strikes — Zaporizhzhia
properties.summary: New wave of airstrikes in Zaporizhzhia. Industrial targets. 2 dead, 18 injured.

properties.title: Ballistic missiles on Kharkiv
properties.summary: Ukrainian Air Force confirms ballistic missile launch on Kharkiv.

properties.title: US 3rd carrier group in Middle East — Iran tensions
properties.summary: USS Theodore Roosevelt joins 2 existing CSGs. US warns of Iranian 'dirty bomb' plot vs DC. Unconfirmed by DOJ/FBI charging documents.

properties.title: West Bank shooting — Palestinian woman killed
properties.summary: Palestinian woman killed, 10 injured in West Bank shooting involving Israeli settlers. Nov 17.

properties.title: Houthi drones strike Riyadh
properties.summary: Explosions rock Saudi capital Riyadh after Houthi drone attack. Saudi forces claim intercept.

properties.title: Russia aircraft enters Korean ADIZ
properties.summary: South Korea scrambles fighter jets after Russian military aircraft enters Korean Air Defense Identification Zone. Japan also scrambles jets over suspected Russian aircraft same day.

properties.title: Trump ASEAN/Quad summit — Manila
properties.summary: Trump arrives Manila for first Quad leaders summit of second term. ASEAN summit. Then moves to Shenzhen for APEC and historic Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral Nov 19.
